Supported Algorithms:
SHA-256, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-512

verify_file_hint: For each source file and each selected algorithm, generates a same-named file in its directory: .md5 / .sha1 / .sha256 / .sha512 / .sfv (CRC32). Usable directly with md5sum -c and similar tools.
multiple_files_hint: There are multiple files in the list. Quick compare will only compare the first two files.

invalid_hash_format: Invalid hash format, please enter valid hexadecimal characters

drag_hint: Drop files or folders here, or click to add. Verification files can also be imported.
